title: F-35B Lightning II: MCAS Miramar Air Show
description: The F-35B Lightning II demonstrates its capabilities from short vertical takeoff and landing to great maneuverability during the 2018 MCAS Miramar Air Show, MCAS Miramar, September 29.   This year's air show honors "100 years of women in the Marine Corps" featuring several performances and displays that highlight the accomplishments and milestones women have made since the first female enlistee, Opha May Johnson, who joined the service in 1918.
